actors.name: Jair Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized in an intensive care unit due to an intestinal obstruction, drawing continuous national and international attention. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the temporary removal of his electronic ankle monitor during his hospital stay. Meanwhile, allies and family members are actively updating the public while political debate around his legal status intensifies.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.role: Leader of Rassemblement National in France
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen is at the center of French media attention following an investigation into leaked interior ministry documents reportedly found at an associate's residence, which she publicly denies receiving. Concurrently, she is outlining strategy for the 2027 presidential race and sparring with rival right-wing figures like David Lisnard. Her party's stance on fiscal constitutional rules and pension reform also drives parliamentary discourse.

Milei also made headlines by celebrating Tesla's official commercial arrival in Argentina.
